content.short: Polymarket is the largest prediction market, letting users trade on the outcome of real-world events.
content.description: Polymarket is the largest crypto prediction market, where users buy and sell shares on the outcomes of elections, sports, economics and other real-world events, with prices reflecting the crowd's implied probability. Its markets settle on Polygon. In October 2025 Polymarket launched a mini app inside World App, letting World users trade using WLD or USDC from their World wallet, announced by both Polymarket and World.
content.meta: Polymarket is the largest prediction market, trading on real-world outcomes, with a World App mini app on World Chain.
